You will be acting as a Hybrid QA Lead with the skills you bring in on both Manual testing and automation processes. Our Stack Programming language: Python DB: MySQL / Mongo DB DevOps: AWS / Jenkins / K8S Web: Selenium / Playwright/ Postman Mobile: Appium / Android Studio / XCode What you'll be doing Lead and mentor a talented development team, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture Provide technical leadership and ensure best practices in software development Drive the Testing lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions Conduct regular code reviews, offering constructive feedback to improve the team’s skills and output Manage team members' performance and career development Track and record product issues and analyse the problems through various tools, giving feedback to relevant personnel to make corrections Write test plans / test cases and output test reports according to feature requirements Share test-related information with other team members Create automated Web / Mobile / API test cases Track and analyse automated tests to improve test efficiency Develop automated tests and test frameworks Improve our Continuous Integration pipeline Help automate all aspects of the software engineering process What you'll bring Minimum of 4+ Years within a relevant role Minimum 8 years of experience in software testing 2+ years of experience in a leadership role, with experience in mentoring, performance reviews, work allocation Solid understanding of testing types: unit, integration, end-to-end, regression, stress/performance, and API testing Experience with Web / Android / iOS and API manual testing Experience with web debugging and API testing tools (Chrome DevTools, Postman) Working knowledge of relational databases preferably MySQL Strong experience with Python Experience with Automation testing knowledge with REST APIs Experience in test automation for mobile apps (Android and iOS) Experience in Automation testing for web apps (Selenium/ Playwright) Docker and Kubernetes experience would be advantageous Experience in developing and running a Continuous Integration system Familiarity with Jira / Jenkins would be advantageous Even better if you have Working knowledge of NoSQL databases, preferably MongoDB BS / MS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering What’s in it for you Sporty is a remote first company in pursuit of sustainability A competitive salary + individual performance based bonuses every quarter 28 days paid annual leave Our core working hours are 10am-3pm in your local time zone with flexibility outside of this Referral bonuses &
